svg.title: Agentic ML Engineering AWS reference architecture
svg.desc: Spec-driven client workflows use Bedrock and AgentCore, with selected managed ML and data services. The network scaffold is separate, harness routing is opt-in, and asynchronous callback/resume is conditional.
svg.text: Agentic ML Engineering — AWS reference architecture
AWS Sample Solution · spec-driven experiments · code-defined infrastructure and selected runtime adapters
Jobs, queries and endpoints are created when invoked
Inputs used by the configured runtime
Callback target binding and runtime resume
InvokeAgentRuntime · spec + dataset URI · streamed results
2 AZs · 1 NAT · interface and gateway endpoints · flow logs
Runtime/workload attachment is not wired by default
CloudTrail → S3 / CloudWatch Logs → security alarms → SNS. Topic subscriptions are configured separately.
Reference architecture. Default setup: nine CDK stacks plus a separately created AgentCore Runtime.
Official AWS Architecture Icons · asset release 07312026 · editable source and provenance retained with the diagram
